description: This file contains functions for handling unhandled stop reasons in a streaming AI assistant context, including normalization, patching, and stream wrapping logic.

methods.name: formatUnhandledStopReasonErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message indicating an unhandled stop reason.

methods.name: normalizeUnhandledStopReasonMessage
methods.description: Normalizes a message string to extract and format unhandled stop reason errors.

methods.name: patchUnhandledStopReasonInAssistantMessage
methods.description: Patches an assistant message object with normalized stop reason error information.

methods.name: buildUnhandledStopReasonErrorStream
methods.description: Creates a stream that emits an error message related to an unhandled stop reason.

methods.name: wrapStreamHandleUnhandledStopReason
methods.description: Wraps a stream to handle unhandled stop reasons during message retrieval and iteration.
